This smartphone UI screen is from an app titled "Dog Sounds." The main content of this screen is categorized under the "Whining" section, as indicated by the highlighted tab at the top. The screen displays six different dog sounds, each represented by an image of a dog and a corresponding label. The labels for the sounds are:

1. Innocent
2. Puppy
3. Desperate
4. Soft
5. Pity
6. Excited

At the top of the screen, there are additional tabs for other categories of dog sounds, such as "Barking" and "Howling." There are also icons for navigating back, adjusting volume, and sharing the app.
